{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Tales of the Expedition''''' was a rare collection of ancient fictional stories about galactic exploration that were believed to have been written between about [[6000 BBY/Legends|6000 BBY]] and [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. One copy of it was sold by [[Nenmo's Curios]] at the [[Cularin Trade Show]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
